query: Consider ResConnect's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document require that all Confidential Information be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party?
rag_answer:
No.

The ResConnect NDA does not require all Confidential Information to be expressly identified by the disclosing party. Under clause 2.2, information consisting of “any of the commercial secrets of the other party” is covered without an express designation. Only under clause 2.3 does the agreement require “any other information of a confidential nature” to be “designated by such party as confidential.”

judge.gold_summary: 金标表明保密义务覆盖两类信息：其他方的商业机密，以及其他具有机密性质且被披露方指定为机密的信息；因此并非所有机密信息都必须由披露方明确标识。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出 NDA 不要求所有机密信息都被明确标识，并区分第 2.2 项商业机密无需明确指定，仅第 2.3 项其他机密信息需要被指定为机密。
judge.reason: 系统回答与金标关键要点一致，明确覆盖了商业机密无需标识、其他机密信息需标识这一核心差异，因此判定命中。
